mandala-2.title: Rigveda Mandala 2 – Hymns of the Gritsamada Rishi Family
mandala-2.description: Rigveda Mandala 2 contains 43 hymns attributed to the Gritsamada lineage praising deities such as Agni and Indra and reflecting early Vedic ritual traditions.

meta.title: Rigveda Mandala 2 – Hymns of the Gritsamada Rishi Family
meta.description: Rigveda Mandala 2 contains 43 hymns attributed to the Gritsamada lineage praising deities such as Agni and Indra and reflecting early Vedic ritual traditions.

openGraph.title: Rigveda Mandala 2 – Hymns of the Gritsamada Rishis
openGraph.description: Explore Mandala 2 of the Rigveda containing 43 hymns composed by the Gritsamada sages praising Agni, Indra and other Vedic deities.

hymns.title: Rigveda Mandala 2 Hymn 1
hymns.introduction: This hymn belongs to Mandala 2 of the Rigveda. Rigvedic hymns are ancient Vedic verses revealed to sages (Rishis) and dedicated to cosmic principles and deities such as Agni, Indra, Varuna, Surya, Soma and others.
hymns.scripture_text: Traditional Rigvedic hymn verse placeholder. Actual Sanskrit mantra text can be inserted here from Rigveda sources.
hymns.philosophical_explanation: Rigvedic hymns often express reverence for natural forces and cosmic order (Rta). They reflect early Vedic philosophy exploring the relationship between humans, nature and the divine. Many hymns emphasize harmony, sacrifice (yajna), spiritual insight, and the search for truth.
